g.text: The body can start a conversation
V2 / P4 · body events → model decisions → existing execution
Boot / wake, tilt and rapid movement carry measurements.
Body Control detects episodes; rapid-event interval defaults to 10 seconds.
Event evidence + Robot Status + current activity + recent conversation.
The model chooses an intention, or decides no response is needed.
Select speech, camera and supported movement steps.
Results return to the workflow; local balance stays on the P4.
Workflow diagram · implementation does not establish reliable physical reactions.
